acceptance: Retain every attempt. Require unchanged clean bound source/binary and archive/text/counter identity for all completed reports; validate repeated context attribution before selecting next production change. Unsupported counters or incomplete callchains remain explicit and may require separately recorded supplemental work.
claim: Descriptive profiling of unchanged source/binary; no optimization, before/after, registered latency or constant-memory claim.
scope: Whole-process perf/Heaptrack captures include preflight and observers; analyze writer-under-run context explicitly. Perf event-period weights are not timings. Heap allocation work and requested-live peaks are distinct; preserve raw scopes and unknown coverage.
